capabilities: Save a writing baseline for the active editor
Create a CriticMarkup review note from edits since the baseline
Verify that accepting or rejecting the marks restores both texts
Keep named baselines for several notes (Pro)
Create folder review copies with author labels and a change summary (Pro)
disambiguation: It does not apply or accept changes in the source note; it only writes a separate CriticMarkup review file.
extras: Freemium: core features are free without an account; Pro features (named baselines, folder reviews, author labels) need a $5/month or $15 one-time GitHub Sponsors sponsorship. After updates it opens a 'What's new' tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be turned off). Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later; phone, tablet, Windows and Linux were not locally tested.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to compare a note against a saved session baseline and produce a marked-up record of what changed during that session.

relations.evidence: Pro features need a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike: $5 a month or more

summary: Session-based writing review tool that saves a prose baseline and turns later edits into a separate CriticMarkup review note.
